lines.zh: 我扇着胸鳍，贴着沙面滑。
lines.en: I flap my fins and glide above the sand.
A shadow slides across the coral reef.

lines.zh: 我拐弯很轻，几乎不起沙。
lines.en: My turns are soft and hardly stir the sand.

lines.zh: 温水浅海上，我游得舒展。
lines.en: In warm shallows my swimming opens up.
Seagrass brushes along my underside.
I swing around the reef to avoid a crash.

lines.zh: 红草甸里，我的颜色藏得住。
lines.en: In the red meadow my color disappears.
A soft flick of my tail pushes me on.

lines.zh: 我从沙上抬起一点，又落下。
lines.en: I lift a little off the sand, then settle.

lines.zh: 一整片浅海，都是我的路。
lines.en: The whole warm shallows is my road.

lines.zh: 水面有光，我沉在下面走。
lines.en: Light on the surface; I travel underneath it.

lines.zh: 一群小鱼从鳍下钻过去。
lines.en: A school of small fish darts beneath my fin.

lines.zh: 沙脊上滑一段，再落回去。
lines.en: I glide a stretch of sand ridge, then drop.
No hurry; this water is very shallow.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙滑过去，把一只蟹压住
lines.en: I skim the sand and pin a crab beneath me.

lines.zh: 沙面起了一小片烟，又落下去
lines.en: A small cloud of sand rises and settles.

lines.zh: 我抬起尾鞭，又轻轻放下
lines.en: I lift my tail whip and let it fall.

lines.zh: 海草床很深，我慢慢穿过去
lines.en: The seagrass is deep; I glide through it slowly.
I lie flat on the sandy bottom, still.

lines.zh: 我的背埋进沙里，只露眼。
lines.en: My back is in the sand; only my eyes show.
Water passes out through my breathing holes.
Fish swim above; I do not look up.
Sand slowly covers over my back.
This stretch of coral reef is quiet.
I lie low and wait for a crab to pass.
The shallows are warm, perfect for resting.
The barb on my tail stays sheathed.

lines.zh: 海草床里，我看不见外面。
lines.en: Among the seagrass I cannot see outside.

lines.zh: 沙面上有一道我的印子。
lines.en: My outline is pressed into the sand.
When I keep still, fish forget I exist.
After a long while I shift once.
This sand is far softer than the reef.
Where you stand, the water is knee deep.
Your feet dig hollows in the sand.

lines.zh: 我伏得很低，你未必看见。
lines.en: I lie so low you may not see me.
Do not probe the sand with your foot.
Your hands smell of iron and salt.
I lift my head a little from the sand.
You crouch down and the water goes still.

lines.zh: 这条尾上的刺，你看见了吗。
lines.en: Did you notice the barb on my tail?

lines.zh: 我不主动惹你，你也别踩。
lines.en: I will not start it; do not step on me.
Let us each keep a patch of sand.
My tail barb has been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 我背上的沙全被震掉了。
lines.en: The sand on my back is all shaken off.
That blow landed on my soft underside.
I fold my fins and press to the bottom.
Whoever hit me will get it back.
A thread of blood in the water is mine.
It hurts, but not enough to flee.
I turn half around and aim my tail.
A second blow, and my patience is gone.
Six points of life; I can still hold on.
I know the smell of crab anywhere.
Drop the crab and I will start moving.
One piece that small will not feed me.
I do not chase bait; bait often hides a hook.
Put it on the sand, not in a net.
It smells of shell; biting will tell.
I raise my head slowly and watch your hand.
One bite and this meat is gone.
The more you wave it, the less I move.
Hungry as I am, I fear being caught more.
You kicked me and the water went murky.
I was shoved half a metre away.
Sand billows up and I blink it away.
Do not step on my tail; the barb is there.
I hug the bottom; you can push me, slowly.
Your foot comes down and my fins fold.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我从沙床里飞出来。
lines.en: That hit launched me clean out of the sandbed.
I turn half around and slip behind you.
That was no light bump; I will remember.
Step back; I would rather not use the barb.

lines.zh: 我贴着它的鳍边兜圈子。
lines.en: I circle slowly along the edge of its fin.

lines.zh: 两片鳍一起扇，沙都起了。
lines.en: Two sets of fins beat and the sand lifts.

lines.zh: 我贴到它背上，轻轻压着。
lines.en: I press lightly along the top of its back.
The warm shallows make a fine place to settle.
It fans the sand aside to clear me a place.
We bring our undersides together.
My barb stays sheathed so I do not hurt it.
Two shadows overlap on the sand.
Afterwards we each lie nearby.

lines.zh: 红草甸的水色，衬得它好看。
lines.en: The red meadow water suits its colors.
I press this crab down so it stays.
I hold a crab leg in my mouth and chew.
The shell is hard, so I bite the joints.
I swim off with a small crab in my mouth.
This crab will keep me until nightfall.
Another fish comes for it; I flick my tail.

lines.zh: 捡到的东西，我埋进沙里。
lines.en: I bury what I find down in the sand.
The crab shell cracks with a crisp sound.
I eat slowly but leave nothing behind.
This one is enough to rest on.
Something hard-shelled is moving in the sand.
That crab is running surprisingly fast.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑向那只蟹。
lines.en: I slide low over the sand toward that crab.
It hides in a crack; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 上面有个大影子过去了。
lines.en: A big shadow has passed overhead.
I smell the salt of a crab.
This one is too small to bother with.
It is running toward the reef.
One beat of my fin and I am ready.
One quick strike and it is pinned.
I fix on the seam of its shell.
It backs off; I follow half a metre.
My tail is rising very slowly.

lines.zh: 它埋头挖沙，我就扑上去。
lines.en: It digs head down, and I swoop over it.
The sand half buries it, which is perfect.
It raises its claws and I do not back off.
I slide around to its flank.

lines.zh: 蟹的腥味一阵比一阵重。
lines.en: The crab smell grows heavier by the moment.
It is trying to get under the stone.
I wait for one of its legs to show.
I drop onto it and the shell splits.
My barb drives in and it curls up tight.
That blow carries five points of damage.
I bite its claw so it cannot pinch me.
It pinches me; my tail whips back hard.

lines.zh: 沙扬起一片，它看不见了。
lines.en: Sand flies up and it loses sight of me.
I pin it flat against the reef.
Broken shell sinks; I keep on eating.
It still wants to run; I strike again.
The fight ends and I settle back in sand.
I lift my fins up out of the sand.
I land in the warm shallow water here.
The red meadow's color suits me well.
In the seagrass bed I lie low first.
I wake up and my belly is already empty.

lines.zh: 珊瑚礁的影子落在我背上。
lines.en: The coral reef's shadow falls across my back.
Another one is nearby; I make room.
The sand has not settled, so I wait.
It is shallow here and light reaches bottom.
I flap my fins twice to test the water.

lines.zh: 火在水里烧，我背鳍卷了。
lines.en: Fire burns in the water and my fin curls.
Dropped on the sandbed, I bounced twice.
Even in water, I can be smothered.
The blast drives me half an inch into sand.
An arrow passed through my fin and stuck.

lines.zh: 身上起了一层麻，尾都软。
lines.en: A numbness crawls over me and my tail sags.

lines.zh: 三天没蟹吃，我伏着不动。
lines.en: Three days without crab and I stop moving.
The water flashes and my whole body clenches.
The bottom is gone and even the sand falls.
